title: AVX-512 IFMA batch-affine drain
author: msm2 track

patches.name: 0001-perf-msm-AVX-512-IFMA-batch-affine-drain-for-native-.patch
patches.summary: perf(msm): AVX-512 IFMA batch-affine drain for native Stage 6a

description: Runtime-dispatched native kernel: 8 Montgomery prefix chains in 5×52-bit IFMA lanes, one inversion per drain. Only runs on CPUs with AVX-512 IFMA (inactive on the coordinator VM). Patches 0002-0004 are follow-ups not yet measured in RESULTS.md.

machine.cpu: 4 vCPU Intel Xeon (family 6 model 173), AVX-512 IFMA

correctness.notes: Verified by the msm track on an IFMA machine, with IFMA on and with BB_MSM_NO_IFMA=1 (both 11/11 identical).

summary.notes: Every flow 0.80-0.88; per-flow seconds not published.
